events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW fragrance-and-coffee activation for NEST New York's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, with a complimentary café experience in Chelsea Triangle.
events.what_is_free: Public admission, complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Complimentary lattes and sampling are while supplies last. Current public listings describe the activation as open to the public and do not publish an RSVP or approval requirement.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 10 AM–9 PM in Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. Arrive earlier if the complimentary latte is the priority because inventory is limited.

events.event_name: The Nitro Bar × Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A two-day Reese's and The Nitro Bar truck pop-up debuting the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte with Halloween-themed giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 complimentary Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised each day, each with a recipe card and Reese's Pumpkins. The first 100 guests each day can also receive a limited-edition koozie, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Giveaways are quantity-limited and can end before the listed closing time. Current listings describe the pop-up as free admission and open to the public; no RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: September 14 and 15 from 11 AM–5 PM at Astor Place by 26 Astor Place. Treat the end time as a maximum because the activation can end when supplies run out.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded NYFW truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with shade sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, Dewy Lip Shine sampling and branded sweet treats are advertised; quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The event is explicitly described as open to the public. Product samples and treats are promotional inventory and may run out.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. No advance RSVP or host approval requirement is published.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: An oversized public beauty activation at Gansevoort Plaza built around Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with touch-ups, product discovery and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: The event advertises free full-size Mary Kay makeup and skin-care products plus beauty touch-ups; promotional inventory is limited.
events.caveats: Current listings explicitly say the event is free and open to the public. Full-size product giveaways are promotional inventory and are not guaranteed to remain available throughout the day.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. No advance RSVP or organizer approval requirement is published.
